summary: Full re-test of StockCount Pro multi-stock feature + 2 defect fixes. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass covering Stocks CRUD, cross-stock data isolation (products, barcodes, stats, reorder, locations all scoped by stock_id), legacy migration (seeded products carry stock_id), and validation (invalid stock_id -> 404, missing stock_id query -> 422). Frontend: stock-switcher pill is present on Home, tapping opens modal with 'Gestisci stock' which navigates to /stocks; creating a stock via new-stock-input + add-stock-btn makes it active and the Home switcher shows the new stock name (query cache invalidated). Scanner defect #1 FIXED: on web preview (camera permission denied) the result bottom sheet now renders — known barcode 8001234500011 shows 'Latte Intero 1L' sheet with scan-next; unknown barcode shows 'Codice non trovato' with create-from-scan. Product form defect #2 FIXED: /product/new -> Crea prodotto navigates to /inventory with no GO_BACK warning emitted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses Pydantic v1 .dict() API (not blocking).
GET /api/products still regex-matches raw user input in `q` (consider escaping).
backend has no idempotency guard on duplicate (barcode, stock_id) products — business decision, but worth noting.

Pytest runs under xdist default (-n auto) and the TestStocks.test_cannot_delete_only_stock test deletes ALL extra stocks, which races with TestIsolation fixtures on another worker. Mitigated by running serially; consider marking as serial or using unique DB per worker.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures create and delete TEST_* and UI_Stock_* stocks + TEST_UI_* products. Final cleanup pass removed all remaining test data. Only the seeded 'Negozio Principale' with 10 sample products + 4 sample locations remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend solid. Frontend: all critical multi-stock flows + both previous defects verified via Playwright on mobile viewport 390x844. If regressions appear, re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_stockcount_api.py -o addopts='' -v` (addopts override disables xdist parallelism which otherwise races on test_cannot_delete_only_stock).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — both defects from iteration_1 are fixed. (1) Scanner result bottom sheet is now rendered outside the camera-granted branch so manual-entry works on web; (2) product/[id].tsx now uses router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/inventory') after save, so direct URL -> create emits no GO_BACK warning and lands on the inventory tab.
